name: ssh
description: Connect to arbitrary remote machines over SSH to run commands and transfer files.

interface.shortDescription: Operate any remote machine over SSH.
interface.longDescription: SSH connects to arbitrary remote machines using the system ssh and scp clients. It supports remote commands, uploads, and downloads with per-call host, user, port, and private-key overrides. It supports an optional per-call password for SSH askpass, never as a command-line argument. The MCP schema marks it writeOnly, though clients may still expose tool inputs in their UI or logs.
defaultPrompt: Run a command on a remote host over SSH.
Upload a local file to a remote host.
Download a file from a remote host.
